scope: Scalar source instructions and canonical R8 image pass functions; no GPU, triangle coverage, MSAA, client pixels or native default wrap verified. Both clamp/repeat and ideal/fixed8 bilinear options tested.
r8_quantization: floor(clamp(x,0,1)*255+0.5)/255 at EACH pass target. D3D FLOAT->UNORM allows 0.6 integer ULP; canonical values are reference, not source GPU bit identity.
native_wrap_boundary: HighlightRender and RenderTextureTracker set no wrap mode. Native Unity defaults have not been recovered. Compare both oracle modes; if borders stay black the output can be mode-independent.
